name: Second Amendment in force after thirty days (r. 1(3))

attrs.quote: These shall come into force after thirty days from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette
attrs.scope: all of the Second Amendment except its regulations 8, 17, 20(a), 20(b) and 21(b)
attrs.note: window is computed: 30 days after publication in the Official Gazette, dated 12 February 2025.
